VOXELMERE

A tiny voxel sandbox

Quick actions
New: building shapes
15 doors (11 woods, Iron, Glass, Copper, Gold) - two blocks tall, right click to open and close. 6 trapdoors, ladders (climb with W or Space, Shift to hold still), slabs and stairs for about 30 materials, 17 fences and 11 walls that join up, glass panes in 17 colours, iron bars and 16 carpets. Stairs, doors and trapdoors face the way you look; click the underside of a block to place an upper slab. Find them in the creative palette under Shapes and Doors, or craft them (6 planks = 3 doors, 3 blocks = 6 slabs, 6 blocks = 4 stairs, 7 sticks = 3 ladders).

v6
About 435 new blocks: 14 rock types (granite, diorite, andesite, basalt, blackstone, deepslate, tuff, marble, limestone, slate, travertine, red sandstone, prismarine, dripstone), each with cobbled, polished, bricks, cracked, mossy, chiseled, tiles and pillar versions. 11 new trees (cherry, dark oak, mangrove, maple, willow, redwood, palm, ebony, bamboo, crimson, warped) with logs, stripped logs, planks, panels, leaves, bookshelves and saplings. 16 colours of concrete, concrete powder, stained glass, glazed tiles, lamps, wool and terracotta. Deepslate ores, copper that weathers, gem blocks, coral, moss, mud, podzol, mycelium and 20 flowers and plants.
Dyes: craft from flowers, bone meal, coal, lapis and cactus, or mix them.
Right click a log with an axe to strip it. Search recipes in the crafting menu.
The world now has rock layers, deepslate deep down, new trees and flowers per biome, coral reefs, crimson and warped forests in the Nether and crystal clusters in the Crystal Caverns.
Realistic animals: detailed pigs, cows, sheep and chickens, plus deer, rabbits, foxes, ducks, horses, goats, wolves, bears, polar bears and spiders. Prey runs from you (sneak up slowly), wolves, bears and goats fight back when hit, spiders climb walls at night. New drops: Leather (Leather Armor), String, Fur.

v5
Two new dimensions: the Crystal Caverns (Amethyst Block portal frame - 4 Amethyst Shards = 1 block) and the Frostlands (Packed Ice frame - 4 Ice = 1 Packed Ice). Light frames with Flint and Steel.
Potions (right click to drink): 2 Glass + 1 Tin Ingot = 3 Bottles. Healing = Bottle + 2 Redstone + Apple. Swiftness = Bottle + Sapphire + Feather (or Frost Crystal). Night Vision = Bottle + 2 Lapis + Carrot (or Lapis + Glowshroom).
Compass (4 Copper + 1 Redstone): hold it to point to your bed / home.
Charms work from your inventory: Lucky Charm (2 Emerald + 2 Gold) sometimes doubles ore drops, Frost Charm (3 Frost Crystal + 1 Diamond) shrugs off lava and fire.
Silver Arrows (4 Arrows + 1 Silver Ingot) hit harder, triple damage to undead.
New blocks: Redstone Lamp, Copper Bricks, Quartz Pillar, Amethyst Block and Bricks, Glow Crystal, Packed Ice, Crystalstone, Permafrost, Glowshrooms.
New mobs: Shades (Crystal Caverns) and Strays (Frostlands - their arrows slow you).

v4
Farming: craft a Hoe, right-click grass to till, plant Wheat Seeds (from tall grass) or Carrots. Crops grow faster near water. Bone Meal (from skeleton bones) speeds growth.
Saplings drop from leaves - plant them to grow trees.
Breeding: hold wheat (cows, sheep), carrots (pigs) or seeds (chickens) - they follow you. Right-click two to breed.
The Nether: build an Obsidian frame (4x5), light it with Flint and Steel (iron + flint from gravel).
The Aether: a Gold Block frame lit the same way opens floating sky islands with Skyrite.
New blocks: pumpkins, melons, hay, jack o'lanterns, quartz, nether bricks, magma, clouds and more. Louder music with a volume slider.

v3
Real lighting: caves are dark, torches, lanterns, glowstone and lava glow. Hold a torch to light your way.
Monsters spawn in the dark, so light up your base!
F5 or O - third-person camera (front / back)
Material sounds, ambient music, view bobbing, brightness setting
Faster chunk building

WASD - move, Shift - sprint
Space - jump / swim
Double-tap Space - fly (Shift = down)
Left / right click - break / place
Middle click - pick block
1-9 / scroll - hotbar
E - place block, Q - break block
Z / X - change block in slot
F - lantern (or hold a torch), N - skip time
G - rain, F3 - debug info
C - crafting (survival) / block palette (creative), hold click to mine
Right click food to eat
M - minimap, V - hold to zoom
Hit pigs and zombies (left click)
B - set home, H - go home
P - screenshot, Shift - dive in water
U or right click - use block (bed, furnace; chests you place store items - chests found in structures hold loot; Shift + right click to place a block on it)
Right click with Bow - shoot arrows
Left click TNT - light the fuse
K - find nearby structures (cycle type)
T, / or Enter - command console: suggestions appear as you type, Tab completes, the / is optional (Esc > Commands lists them all)
I - inventory (equip armor, move items, drop)
Y - skip a tutorial step
J - quest tracker: hide hints / hide / show
Hold breath ~14s underwater
Beware lava, cacti and creepers!
R - respawn, Esc - menu
Game modes: Skyblock (build a cobblestone generator: put water and lava with a one-block gap), OneBlock (mine the centre block - it comes back as something new), Stranded, Skylands, Underground, Lava Sea, Ultra Hardcore and Monster Siege. Water flowing onto lava makes obsidian.
Worlds menu: many saves, export / import, copy a world or turn it into a template. + New World offers 13 templates (Superflat, Skyblock, Archipelago, Amplified, single-biome worlds, Hardcore, Peaceful Farm...) and full customisation: world type, biome, terrain height, sea level, trees, ores, caves, structures, difficulty, starting kit and world rules - with a live map preview. Save your own settings as templates.
Quests: the tracker (top left) guides you step by step to the Titan - Esc > Quests shows the full journey, side quests and rewards
Beat the game: craft the Titan Sigil, use it on Obsidian
World auto-saves
